cards.title: The Protégé Problem
cards.instruction: Treat another player as someone you trained. Offer corrections, backhanded praise, and reminders of your influence.

cards.title: Hope Keeps Moving
cards.instruction: Turn every disappointment into a new reason the desired outcome is delayed, redirected, or becoming more meaningful.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Let's use what I taught you. Our bookshop failed here. We're meant to find readers somewhere else.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: You're nearly doing it my way. Then we're meant to start smaller. One shelf, properly chosen.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: I could get us a market stall beside the bus stop.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: People waiting with nothing to read! I'll pack the short stories. We've been making our customers come too far.

mechanism: A treats a trained bookseller failed shop as an incomplete first attempt, coaching each smaller alternative into the discovery of the right audience.
confusable: Not ordinary practical fallback alone: each disappointing fact becomes a sign the intended outcome is finding its better form.
comparison: Personal ceremony versus commercial customer contact.
